items.name: TEMPORAL_LEAKAGE
items.finding: Target-own/future feature prohibition and same-kickoff immutable histories are enforceable. Require 365d inclusive lower bound and strict kickoff+48h<cutoff for all historical histories. 48h is an unverified retrospective assumption, never actual fetchedAt; final/revised historical values are not strict replay. Any contrary completion evidence is INVALID.

items.name: H2_CAUSALITY
items.finding: Existing read-only causalOffset builds fresh frozen H2 from target-prior history. Design must use that causal state for every training example and scored target, never a full-season hindsight parameter. No target outcome in conditioning.

items.name: REPRESENTATION_TRAINING_LEAKAGE
items.finding: Protocol omission resolved as a binding design constraint: every beta-training example uses representation learned only from its eligible chronological prefix. Separate initial/final 2023 maps are sealed for out-of-sample checks; no learned-map refresh in 2024/2025. Static transforms require no fit. This is design admissibility, not a passed runtime test.

items.name: FEATURE_IDENTITY
items.finding: Reuse exact provider fixture/team IDs, explicit home For/away Against reversal, exact three provider types. Duplicate/invalid values are INVALID; zero distinct from missing. No fuzzy joins or season relabeling.

items.name: MISSINGNESS
items.finding: Keep base-result history and every target ID. Missing feature is excluded from its feature history only; all required-feature count gates and representation-prefix gates must be explicit. Preserve PASS reasons. No denominator repair, imputation or fallback.

items.name: MULTICOLLINEARITY_IDENTIFIABILITY
items.finding: Phase-1 correlated state motivates a low-degree representation; at most two candidates. Design must bound free coefficients and deterministic regularization. Compression can discard incremental signal and conditioning may remove only a restricted functional component; no empirical identifiability or performance claim before tests.

items.name: RESEARCHER_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM
items.finding: At most two fixed candidates; no grid search, league-specific formula, outcome-based deletion or threshold relaxation. Constants selected once from structural reasoning and inherited contracts, not new performance runs.

items.name: COMPARATOR_FAIRNESS
items.finding: Seal outcome-independent fixed U where V1/H2 both predict. Candidate PASS/FAIL cannot remove comparator IDs. Missing U candidate probability nulls primary candidate metrics. Reference Phase-1 comparison cannot change U or promotion.

items.name: DRAW_FIREWALL
items.finding: No draw parameter, multiplier/intercept/threshold, Dixon-Coles or class calibration; ordinary frozen independent-Poisson class rule only.

items.name: HOLDOUT_FIREWALL
items.finding: Only committed 2025 metadata/hash was read. No raw/value/result/probability/metric access. Future implementation must enforce an allowlist and reject season 2025 before file loading until a separate approved stage.

items.name: DETERMINISM
items.finding: Deterministic scalar binary64 order, fixed linear algebra, initialization, convergence and fail rules can be specified; input/source/map/beta hashes mandatory. No random starts or solver fallback. Execution remains unauthorized.

items.name: STATISTICAL_INTERPRETATION
items.finding: 2024 is already exposed; two further candidates still create researcher degrees of freedom. Descriptive only, no pooled winner, no significance claim or promotion. Independent 2025 remains sealed; learned-map generalization and prefix/deployment map differences must be disclosed.

items.name: DATA_RIGHTS_STORAGE
items.finding: Existing conditional internal use is retained; raw stays LOCAL_ONLY. Provider Chat AI guidance is not formal license or human confirmation. Public/commercial rights unresolved; no new data requests or public raw release.

payload.interpretation: No BLOCKING findings. RISK_NOTED limitations remain disclosed; PASS is a design-control assessment, not implementation/fit/performance validation. Subsequent design must implement every stated constraint. No candidate selected at this audit seal.

selection.reason: R1 directly tests restricted H2-conditional process information. R3 fixed projection is a low-degree unresidualized representation control using the identical all-feature composites, separating compression from the additional conditioning operation. Both have two rate coefficients and identical features/normalization.

rejected.R2: Not selected: recent/baseline innovation would introduce extra window definitions and conflate temporal recency with conditioning. No claim of inferior predictive performance.
rejected.learnedPCA: Not selected: fixed projection avoids eigensolver/sign/tie/fit-season degrees of freedom. No PCA performance evaluated.

selection.performanceExpectation: NONE; no performance-selected constants or candidate winner

temporal.eligibility: same league; Regular Season FT; distinct fixture ID; kickoff(m)>=C(T)-365 days; kickoff(m)+48 hours<C(T); authorized source seasons only; all venues
temporal.justification: Owner explicitly permits 48h retrospective assumption, consistent with frozen v1/v2 chronology; census proves final/revised presence only and two still-missing current observations do not establish publication latency. No empirical publication guarantee.
temporal.contradictoryCompletionEvidence: INVALID_TEMPORAL_CONTRACT; no selective repair or shortening lag
temporal.simultaneousKickoffs: One immutable history per kickoff group; fixture ID orders output only
temporal.forward: Actual observed completed-match features with providerFetchedAt<=predictionCreatedAt only; never use synthetic 48h timestamps. No Forward implementation here.

sourceSeasons.holdout: NOT_AUTHORIZED; later separately approved target history may include 2023/2024/2025 under same cutoff, but learned maps/betas remain final-2023

aggregation.pool: For feature f independently, M_f(T) is eligible base-history matches with valid non-null f for BOTH exact team IDs. Completeness of unregistered features must not affect the candidate.
aggregation.validity: Exactly one matching provider type per expected team; finite nonnegative number or trimmed decimal numeric string; shots/SOT integer. Zero is present. Null/absent/block unavailable are missing. Duplicate identity/type, negative/invalid/nonfinite raw values or hash mismatch are INVALID, not dropped.
aggregation.mapping: Home team For=f_home and Against=f_away; away team For=f_away and Against=f_home. Do not negate Against. League reference counts both team For values once per match.
aggregation.means: n_tf=count of M_f(T) involving t; muFor_tf=sum For/n_tf; muAgainst_tf=sum Against/n_tf; L_f=sum over M_f(T)(f_home+f_away)/(2*|M_f(T)|). All arithmetic means, uniform weights, all venues.
aggregation.normalization: zFor_tf=ln(muFor_tf)-ln(L_f); zAgainst_tf=ln(muAgainst_tf)-ln(L_f), mathematically log ratio. No epsilon, clipping, standardization, feature mean shrinkage or imputation.
aggregation.zeroRule: Any required mean or reference exactly zero => PASS_NONPOSITIVE_FEATURE_MEAN; nonfinite arithmetic => FAIL_NUMERICAL. Min-count check precedes means. Invalid raw values are INVALID_INPUT before aggregation.
aggregation.featureIndependentMasks: Both V31-R1 and V31-R3 require xG, shots, sot. Each feature has its own complete prior pool; do not replace with joint-complete match intersection. Require min 5 for each feature and both target teams.
aggregation.order: Matches kickoffUtc then numeric fixtureId; per match home then away; features xG,shots,sot; coefficients For then Against; all scalar reductions left-to-right binary64.

projection.authoritativeArithmetic: Use explicit sum then divide by 3, not a matrix multiplication with pre-rounded 1/3. q=[For,opponent Against].
projection.fitSeason: NONE; design-time constants fixed for every season/league
projection.centeringScaling: Only inherited per-feature causal log/league normalization; no learned centering, variance scaling or norm normalization.
projection.signConvention: All three weights positive; positive q means above league process mean; component order For then opponent Against.
projection.outOfSample: Same fixed projection for every target; no refit.
projection.reason: Keep all three allowed features while reducing six raw covariates to two symmetric process composites. Equal weight is a design prior, not an estimated winner or evidence of independence from H2.

frozenSpecification.name: FROZEN_V2_H2
frozenSpecification.fitPolicy: For each target and each beta-training example, fresh causal frozen H2 fit using its same-league 365d/48h result pool and unchanged 30/5/5, universe, objective, optimizer, caps and PASS rules. Offset must never come from a full-season fit containing that example or later results.
frozenSpecification.adapterPolicy: Existing season guards stay untouched. Any future V3-scoped season adapter must preserve identities, not relabel 2025 as 2024, and pass equivalence tests on 2023/2024 before authorization; no 2025 access here.

h2.contract: Every target or training anchor uses fresh frozen H2 estimator on its own eligible base-result history. Preserve 30/5/5 and unseen-team gates, optimizer, regularization and rate rules exactly. No full-season H2 parameter reuse. Exact same eligible history for both candidates and H2 comparator.
h2.conditioning: h_s=[1,log(lambda_H2_s),log(lambda_H2_opponent)]; ordering is scorer then opponent; same coefficient maps shared across home/away.
h2.noTargetLabel: lambda_H2 is generated before anchor cutoff from prior completed results only. Anchor score and own process stats cannot enter h or q. These causal rates are model state, not future-outcome proxies.
h2.limitations: Conditioning removes a regularized linear component in the TWO H2 log-rate summaries, not every nonlinear/team latent component of H2 and not full statistical independence.

representation.objective: For j=For,Against separately: minimize L(a_j)=(1/(2M))*sum_r(q_rj-h_r dot a_j)^2+(0.01/2)*(a_j1^2+a_j2^2). r iterates home then away for N distinct eligible anchors; M=2N. Intercept unpenalized.
representation.normalEquation: A=(sum_r h_r h_r^T)/M+diag(0,0.01,0.01); b_j=(sum_r h_r q_rj)/M; solve A*a_j=b_j. No target scores or process stats are regression responses: q is its anchor-prior process composite.
representation.gateRationale: Fixed structural overdetermination gate for three columns with ten side observations; not a power claim or performance-selected threshold. Dependence between sides is disclosed.
representation.solver: Unpivoted Cholesky in column order 0,1,2; ascending lower-triangle accumulation, forward/back substitution. Reuse A factor only for the two RHS within the identical pool; no alternate solver, pivoting, jitter, random initialization, grid or restart.
representation.verification: Require all finite, all Cholesky pivots strictly positive, and infinity norm(A*a_j-b_j)<=1e-10*(1+maxAbs(b_j)) for each j. A is positive definite mathematically for any nonempty pool because the intercept has positive count and slopes have positive ridge. Numerical failure remains failure.
representation.transform: r_sj=q_sj-h_s dot a_j; ordered dot from index0 to2. No residual clipping, standardization, centering, renormalization or label-dependent correction.
representation.exactInterpretation: Ridge residual is not exactly orthogonal to slope columns: (H^T*r)/M=diag(0,0.01,0.01)*a. Intercept residual mean is zero up to solver tolerance on its own training pool. Out-of-sample residuals need not have zero mean/correlation. Incremental signal is a hypothesis, not guaranteed by residualization.
representation.baseAnchorPopulation: B is every season-2023 full-cohort anchor with PREDICTED causal H2 and valid all-required-feature pregame q. Construct each anchor from its own cutoff history. Normal H2/feature PASS excluded only from representation likelihood with full census; FAIL/INVALID prevents required fit. B does not depend on R1 residual eligibility or labels: no recursion.
representation.prefixTiming: For beta-training anchor T, P(T)={m in B: same league, kickoff(m)>=C(T)-365d AND kickoff(m)+48h<C(T)}. Fit a(T) from P(T), requiring >=5 distinct fixtures, and transform T with a(T) only. Never use T, same-kickoff anchors, or later anchor states. P(T) is independent of candidate results. Every q_m and h_m was already causal at m.
representation.stageMaps: Initial check map: fit B with kickoff<2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z and kickoff+48h<boundary. Final map: fit all B from season2023, only after max2023Kickoff+48h+1ms. Both require >=5 anchors. These maps are used only out-of-sample; never replace stored prefix maps in beta training.
representation.noRefit: Initial map held fixed throughout internal check; final map held fixed throughout 2024 and any separately approved 2025 check. Neither representation response nor map fit can use 2024/2025 anchors. Current causal target history may update; learned map may not.
representation.complexity: Active scored model has 6 nuisance coefficients + 2 beta per league/stage. Training also estimates many six-coefficient prefix maps; 8 is active parameter count, not total estimation count or an effective-df claim.
representation.deploymentMismatch: Beta is trained on causal prefix residuals and evaluated with a fixed end-of-training map. This prevents in-sample lookahead but may cause scale/distribution differences. Retain hashes and descriptive diagnostics; no recalibration or repair after results.

betaFitting.scope: Independent two-beta fit per league x candidate; no pooling/cross-candidate initialization.
betaFitting.objective: J(beta)=(1/(2N))*sum_i[exp(o_iH+X_iH dot beta)-y_iH*(o_iH+X_iH dot beta)+exp(o_iA+X_iA dot beta)-y_iA*(o_iA+X_iA dot beta)]+(0.01/2)*sum_j beta_j^2; o=ln(causal frozen H2 rate); omit log-factorial constants.
betaFitting.parameters: [beta_For,beta_Against], unconstrained shared sides; no intercept/draw/interaction; X is R1 residual r or R3 q. H2 and representation coefficients held fixed while optimizing beta.
betaFitting.optimizer: Deterministic damped Newton with unpivoted Cholesky solve H*d=-g; column/index order ascending; no jitter, alternate solver or restart.
betaFitting.convergence: At initialization and after accepted updates, max(abs(g))<=1e-7; max accepted updates=100. Small objective change alone is not convergence.
betaFitting.lineSearch: At each update test alpha=2^(-j), j=0..59; first finite positive-rate trial with J(beta+alpha*d)<=J(beta)+1e-4*alpha*dot(g,d) accepted. Reject overflow/underflow trials without clipping. If none: FAIL_LINE_SEARCH.
betaFitting.failure: Nonpositive Cholesky pivot, nonfinite accepted state or g dot d>=0 before convergence => FAIL_NUMERICAL. 100 updates without convergence => FAIL_NON_CONVERGENCE. No beta=0/H2 fallback after failure.
betaFitting.insufficient: Fewer than 30 valid two-equation causal examples => PASS_INSUFFICIENT_FIT / experiment INSUFFICIENT; no class-count gate for Poisson fitting.
betaFitting.trainingRates: Finite positive likelihood rates; no target cap of 10 inside beta likelihood. Prediction output rate cap remains 10.

development.initialFit: Season2023 anchors kickoff<boundary and kickoff+48h<boundary. R1 uses prefix-map residual per anchor, R3 fixed q. Require >=30 valid beta examples. Initial R1 map fitted separately from B before check. Fit each beta from zero with inherited optimizer; no tune based on internal check.
development.internalCheck: All season2023 targets kickoff>=boundary. Freeze initial beta and initial R1 map. H2/q target state remains causal and updates with eligible 2023 history. Pre-boundary anchors whose 48h has not elapsed at boundary remain audited but are not moved into internal check.
development.finalFit: At time strictly after max season2023 kickoff+48h, fit beta once from all eligible season2023 causal examples using saved prefix-map residuals (R1) or fixed q (R3). Fit final R1 map separately from all B. Seal final map/beta/input hashes before 2024 candidate result access.
development.exposed: Season2024 full cohort; final-2023 beta and R1 map immutable. No representation fit/refit, beta refit, feature selection or structural changes from 2024 outcomes. H2 and q may consume earlier eligible 2024 results/features as causal history only.
development.holdout: Not executed or authorized. Future approved 2025 stage must reuse identical final-2023 beta/map hashes; no 2024/2025 learned-map or beta refit.
development.fitCensus: Each fit records full eligible/noneligible anchor identities and reasons. FAIL/INVALID cannot be dropped. Insufficient initial or final map/beta fit => experiment INSUFFICIENT. Normal row PASS does not imply experiment FAIL.

invalid: Target/future/foreign-league input; wrong season; relabeling; duplicate identity/type; forbidden input
Invalid raw value or temporal contract contradiction
fail: Nonfinite/nonpositive computed rates or nonfinite aggregate
status.missingStageMap: If required initial/final map has fewer than5 anchors, experiment INSUFFICIENT and row PASS_INSUFFICIENT_REPRESENTATION_HISTORY; do not substitute zeros or R3/H2.
status.propagation: Integrity first; then causal H2, feature min counts and positive means, R1 map integrity/eligibility, final rates/mass. A required upstream FAIL/INVALID halts the fit/candidate stage and emits its status; do not silently continue a fit after dropping it. Other independent candidate remains separately reported only if shared integrity is valid.
status.executionScreen: PASS means valid completed fit/check, not performance improvement; no score-based override. Metrics null when U incomplete; report INCOMPLETE_PRIMARY_COVERAGE without shrinking U.

comparison.population: For each league/phase, N is every frozen target. Before candidate execution and without consulting outcomes/features, seal U={IDs where frozen V1 and frozen H2 both PREDICTED} and comparator probabilities/hashes. Never import V2 paired IDs as V3 universe.
comparison.candidateMissing: If candidate does not predict every ID in U, primary LL/Brier/class metrics are null with INCOMPLETE_PRIMARY_COVERAGE; do not drop targets or substitute comparator probabilities. Optional common-subset metric not produced in this design.
comparison.extraPredictions: Predictions outside U retained as operational evidence only, never added to primary comparison denominator.

metrics.logLoss: mean(-ln(max(pActual,1e-15))), scoring-only floor; report floor-hit count
metrics.brier: mean(sum_c(p_c-y_c)^2), no division by class count
metrics.ece: Per-class 10 equal bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; ECE=sum(n_b/|U|)*abs(meanP_b-frequency_b); empty bins retained with null means; n_b<20 flagged low sample
metrics.undefined: No required-class actual samples => required recall null and promotion INSUFFICIENT
metrics.delta: candidate minus comparator on identical U, unrounded

comparison.aggregation: Each league separately, both comparators; no pooled historical/Forward or league-weighted winner score
comparison.reference: Both use Phase-1 F3 as feature-set-matched descriptive reference only, because all three feature families retained. Logical comparison is registered now; no candidate mapping by observed performance. Compare existing sealed F3 only if exact stage IDs and U and comparator contracts match, else REFERENCE_NOT_COMPARABLE without rerun/subsetting. No reference required for promotion.
comparison.order: Freeze sources/specs; for each phase seal V1/H2 U and probabilities before candidate outputs. Candidate order V31-R1 then V31-R3. Seal candidate pregame outputs before joining stage outcomes for scoring. Beta fitting joins only eligible training labels via separate interface.

probabilities.model: Independent Poisson, no Dixon-Coles or temperature/DRAW correction
probabilities.rates: Require finite 0<lambda_home,lambda_away<=10; positive >10 => PASS; nonfinite/nonpositive computed => FAIL_NUMERICAL
probabilities.grid: For each marginal start P0=exp(-lambda), recurse Pk=P(k-1)*lambda/k; include k>=1 and extend until 1-cumulative<=1e-12 with k<=199. If tail unmet at cap: INVALID. Sum joint in ascending home-score then away-score order.
probabilities.mass: Require Z finite positive and abs(1-Z)<=3e-12; normalize joint once by Z. HOME i>j, DRAW i=j, AWAY i<j. Final probabilities finite in [0,1], sum error<=1e-10. Evaluator does not repair.
probabilities.classRule: Ordinary argmax with exact-tie HOME then DRAW then AWAY; no threshold
probabilities.arithmetic: IEEE754 binary64, no randomness or rounded comparison inputs

common.arithmetic: Binary64; sorted kickoff ascending then numeric fixtureId; home then away; features xG/shots/sot; component For then Against; column order 0,1,2; scalar left-to-right sums; fixed Node/runtime version logged at future source seal. No BLAS parallel reductions, randomness, rounding comparisons, solver fallback or tuning.
common.population: Unchanged frozen four-league Regular Season cohort: 2023=1446,2024=1446 (39/140/135 each380,78=306). 2025 seal metadata only,1446. No new cohort read or candidate metric computation in this mission.

REPRESENTATION_FIT.authoritativeArithmetic: Use explicit sum then divide by 3, not a matrix multiplication with pre-rounded 1/3. q=[For,opponent Against].
REPRESENTATION_FIT.fitSeason: NONE; design-time constants fixed for every season/league
REPRESENTATION_FIT.centeringScaling: Only inherited per-feature causal log/league normalization; no learned centering, variance scaling or norm normalization.
REPRESENTATION_FIT.signConvention: All three weights positive; positive q means above league process mean; component order For then opponent Against.
REPRESENTATION_FIT.outOfSample: Same fixed projection for every target; no refit.
REPRESENTATION_FIT.reason: Keep all three allowed features while reducing six raw covariates to two symmetric process composites. Equal weight is a design prior, not an estimated winner or evidence of independence from H2.

TEMPORAL_RULE.eligibility: same league; Regular Season FT; distinct fixture ID; kickoff(m)>=C(T)-365 days; kickoff(m)+48 hours<C(T); authorized source seasons only; all venues
TEMPORAL_RULE.justification: Owner explicitly permits 48h retrospective assumption, consistent with frozen v1/v2 chronology; census proves final/revised presence only and two still-missing current observations do not establish publication latency. No empirical publication guarantee.
TEMPORAL_RULE.contradictoryCompletionEvidence: INVALID_TEMPORAL_CONTRACT; no selective repair or shortening lag
TEMPORAL_RULE.simultaneousKickoffs: One immutable history per kickoff group; fixture ID orders output only
TEMPORAL_RULE.forward: Actual observed completed-match features with providerFetchedAt<=predictionCreatedAt only; never use synthetic 48h timestamps. No Forward implementation here.

sourceSeasons.holdout: NOT_AUTHORIZED; later separately approved target history may include 2023/2024/2025 under same cutoff, but learned maps/betas remain final-2023

frozenSpecification.name: FROZEN_V2_H2
frozenSpecification.fitPolicy: For each target and each beta-training example, fresh causal frozen H2 fit using its same-league 365d/48h result pool and unchanged 30/5/5, universe, objective, optimizer, caps and PASS rules. Offset must never come from a full-season fit containing that example or later results.
frozenSpecification.adapterPolicy: Existing season guards stay untouched. Any future V3-scoped season adapter must preserve identities, not relabel 2025 as 2024, and pass equivalence tests on 2023/2024 before authorization; no 2025 access here.

H2_CONDITIONING.contract: Every target or training anchor uses fresh frozen H2 estimator on its own eligible base-result history. Preserve 30/5/5 and unseen-team gates, optimizer, regularization and rate rules exactly. No full-season H2 parameter reuse. Exact same eligible history for both candidates and H2 comparator.
H2_CONDITIONING.conditioning: h_s=[1,log(lambda_H2_s),log(lambda_H2_opponent)]; ordering is scorer then opponent; same coefficient maps shared across home/away.
H2_CONDITIONING.noTargetLabel: lambda_H2 is generated before anchor cutoff from prior completed results only. Anchor score and own process stats cannot enter h or q. These causal rates are model state, not future-outcome proxies.
H2_CONDITIONING.limitations: Conditioning removes a regularized linear component in the TWO H2 log-rate summaries, not every nonlinear/team latent component of H2 and not full statistical independence.

beta.scope: Independent two-beta fit per league x candidate; no pooling/cross-candidate initialization.
beta.objective: J(beta)=(1/(2N))*sum_i[exp(o_iH+X_iH dot beta)-y_iH*(o_iH+X_iH dot beta)+exp(o_iA+X_iA dot beta)-y_iA*(o_iA+X_iA dot beta)]+(0.01/2)*sum_j beta_j^2; o=ln(causal frozen H2 rate); omit log-factorial constants.
beta.parameters: [beta_For,beta_Against], unconstrained shared sides; no intercept/draw/interaction; X is R1 residual r or R3 q. H2 and representation coefficients held fixed while optimizing beta.
beta.optimizer: Deterministic damped Newton with unpivoted Cholesky solve H*d=-g; column/index order ascending; no jitter, alternate solver or restart.
beta.convergence: At initialization and after accepted updates, max(abs(g))<=1e-7; max accepted updates=100. Small objective change alone is not convergence.
beta.lineSearch: At each update test alpha=2^(-j), j=0..59; first finite positive-rate trial with J(beta+alpha*d)<=J(beta)+1e-4*alpha*dot(g,d) accepted. Reject overflow/underflow trials without clipping. If none: FAIL_LINE_SEARCH.
beta.failure: Nonpositive Cholesky pivot, nonfinite accepted state or g dot d>=0 before convergence => FAIL_NUMERICAL. 100 updates without convergence => FAIL_NON_CONVERGENCE. No beta=0/H2 fallback after failure.
beta.insufficient: Fewer than 30 valid two-equation causal examples => PASS_INSUFFICIENT_FIT / experiment INSUFFICIENT; no class-count gate for Poisson fitting.
beta.trainingRates: Finite positive likelihood rates; no target cap of 10 inside beta likelihood. Prediction output rate cap remains 10.

invalid: Target/future/foreign-league input; wrong season; relabeling; duplicate identity/type; forbidden input
Invalid raw value or temporal contract contradiction
fail: Nonfinite/nonpositive computed rates or nonfinite aggregate

prerequisites: Frozen implementation, comparators, input and beta hashes
All four leagues evaluated once without rerun or tuning
originalRule.primary: Per candidate, every league, and each comparator separately: delta LL < -1e-12 AND delta multiclass Brier < -1e-12.
originalRule.classGuards: Every HOME/DRAW/AWAY versus each comparator on the fixed primary population: recall delta >= -0.05-1e-12; ECE delta <= 0.01+1e-12; one-vs-rest Brier delta <= 1e-12.
originalRule.coverage: Fixed comparator intersection U contains at least 100 fixtures and >=80% of full league cohort; candidate predicts 100% of U; all full-cohort IDs retained; zero FAIL/INVALID; all three actual classes present in U.
originalRule.nullHandling: Null required recall/ECE or missing primary probabilities => INSUFFICIENT, never silently pass. Precision null is reported, not a promotion guard.
originalRule.outcome: ELIGIBLE_FOR_CTO_PROMOTION_REVIEW only if all four leagues pass all gates; otherwise SCREEN_NO, INSUFFICIENT, FAIL or INVALID as applicable. No model promotion or automatic Forward migration.
originalRule.multipleCandidates: Evaluate all F1/F2/F3 separately; no composite winner, league cherry-picking, unregistered ensemble or automatic choice among passing candidates.
originalRule.exposed2024: DESCRIPTIVE_CHECK_ONLY; report numeric metrics and differences, no promotion eligibility from these data
originalRule.rationale: Fixed conservative descriptive eligibility guardrails, not a significance test: common denominators, both probability scores improve, class recall capped at 5 percentage-point loss and ECE at 1 point. No claim that these constants were empirically optimized.

promotion.candidateEnumerationOverride: Apply every original numeric and integrity gate to V31-R1 and V31-R3 separately; historical F1/F2/F3 names in copied evidence are not extra candidates.
promotion.prerequisitesInAdditionToOriginal: All V3.1 protocol/design/source/tests and2023development/2024exposed stages complete; separate explicit CTO approval; 2025 still not authorized.

diagnostics.scope: Future descriptive reports only; none computed now
diagnostics.population: On exact fixed U if complete; otherwise diagnostics may report available pregame state with explicit counts, never substitute primary metrics.
diagnostics.statistics: Per league/candidate Pearson and Spearman average tied ranks; zero variance=>null. All allowed pregame representation components versus each H2 log-rate and one another; no outcome-conditioned selection. Contribution quantiles linear interpolation (n-1)q at p10,p25,median,p75,p90 and maximum absolute, rates ratio likewise. Initial/final active map/beta values/signs and absolute delta, relative abs delta divided by abs initial (zero=>null). Prefix fit counts/ranges/hashes recorded; no confidence/significance claim.
diagnostics.caveat: Training sides, repeated teams and overlapping histories are dependent. Ridge residual not fully decorrelated. Low-dimensional fixed projection can discard useful contrast. Prefix versus fixed map scale may differ.
